title: Oil Mod
description: Some animals(Pig, Cow, Sheep) will drop oil fat that can synthesize "powerful" incendiary oil bottles.
body:
Some animals(Pig, Cow, Sheep) will drop oil fat that can synthesize "powerful" incendiary oil bottles.

"Oil Fat" will drop off when killing pigs, cows and sheep.

Added A Special Effect.

You can use 3 Oil Fats with a Glass Bottle to craft a Oil Bottle.

![Craft Method Is As Above](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/104265ea5de8ecf1c11c071c0a442fe1b112f90d_0.webp)
